tool_args.rationale: The three pilot signatures jointly favor the archived spatio-temporal siphon-memory ODE. The fine trajectory batch is the only offered probe that can distinguish fast memory relaxation from its coupling to the observed state before fitting and fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoint observations for five parameters leave no residual degrees of freedom, and all horizons are well beyond the characteristic time scale, making fast relaxation hard to separate from coupling strength.
It captures the base field and sink gradient but has no mechanism for the observed coupled transient lag.
It does not resolve the coupling and relaxation ambiguity.
